messages:
incident-bot: Paging oncall_eng: KV-cache growth anomaly detected for continuous-batching pool 'cb-pool-3'. Memory per-worker rising, evictions not keeping up. Alert threshold breached (92%).

alice: I’m on it. seeing a spike in kv_cache_keys_in_use and steady increase in write amplification.

bob: do we know if it's a customer-pattern? any recent deploys to batching config?

carlos: yesterday afternoon we rolled batch_window_ms from 30 -> 100 for latency smoothing on cb-pool-3. Not sure that should cause unbounded keys though.

emily: support reports higher error rates for customer acct-3745, 5xxs and timeouts. filing incident ticket.

alice: adding logs: 1789456790 - sample from worker-17: 
```
kv_cache_keys_in_use: 1.2M
kv_cache_ram_bytes: 6.3GB
batch_queue_len: 42
prefix_kv_hits: 0.2
```
looks like prefix caching is not matching; keys exploding.

bob: hypothesis: a client is sending high-entropy prefixes (unique per request) so kv cache entries never reused -> continuous batching holds onto many unique keys.

dave: paging infra note: cb-pool-3 is in us-east-1, 8xA100. This hit started ~1789456720.

fiona: is customer acct-3745 on any special rollout? feature flags?

emily: acct-3745 recently enabled 'session_per_prompt' experimental toggle in app, rolled out yesterday. Could be related.

alice: ok mitigation options: 1) reduce batch_window_ms back to 30 for the pool. 2) enable per-customer override to force batching off for acct-3745. 3) evict kv cache aggressively (risking perf).

carlos: I prefer per-customer override while we investigate; minimal blast radius.

bob: agree. canary rollout to 5% of acct traffic first? we need to toggle via flags service.

deploy-bot: Available commands: `/ff toggle <flag> <on|off> --target <selector>` or use API `POST /flags/toggle`.

alice: doing the API call to set per-customer override to "batching: disabled" for acct-3745, canary 5% -> 0.05. posting curl.

```
curl -X POST https://flags.internal/api/toggle \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' \
  -d '{"flag":"cb_disable_for_customer","target":{"customer_id":"acct-3745","canary":0.05}}'
```

deploy-bot: flag cb_disable_for_customer set: target acct-3745 canary 5% — queued for evaluation.

analytics-bot: metric subscription created: kv_cache_keys_in_use (cb-pool-3), p95_latency, error_rate for acct-3745. alerting threshold at 80%.

alice: initial canary ramp started at 1789456845. monitoring.

1789456880 alice: canary logs show 5% of acct-3745 traffic hitting non-batched path, kv key creation rate decreased slightly.

1789456905 bob: still seeing overall keys rising but slope reduced. per-customer bucket for acct-3745 keys growth plateauing.

carlos: looks promising. propose to increase canary to 25% in 2 min, then 100% if stable.

alice: doing the 25% update now.

```
curl -X POST https://flags.internal/api/toggle \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' \
  -d '{"flag":"cb_disable_for_customer","target":{"customer_id":"acct-3745","canary":0.25}}'
```

deploy-bot: cb_disable_for_customer updated for acct-3745 -> 25% canary.

1789456962 emily: support noticed reduction in errors for some sessions. reported 500->200 per minute drop for affected endpoints.

alice: at 25% we still see residual growth but within eviction capacity. I want to start scheduled per-worker LRU eviction at 60s TTL for unaccessed keys as precaution. carlos ok?

carlos: fine, we can toggle ttl via runtime flag on pool. command below.

```
# runtime admin
runtimectl set pool cb-pool-3 kv_ttl_seconds=60
```

1789456992 deploy-bot: runtime flag applied to cb-pool-3: kv_ttl_seconds=60 (rolling to workers).

bob: monitoring memory and p99 latency closely, TTL evictions may increase tail latency for cold keys. keep an eye.

1789457045 analytics-bot: kv_cache_keys_in_use slope decreased 70% vs peak. memory per-worker dropping.

alice: canary to 100% for acct-3745 now to remove source of entropy.

```
curl -X POST https://flags.internal/api/toggle \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' \
  -d '{"flag":"cb_disable_for_customer","target":{"customer_id":"acct-3745","canary":1.0}}'
```

deploy-bot: cb_disable_for_customer set for acct-3745 -> 100%.

1789457140 emily: support confirms errors returned to baseline for acct-3745.

carlos: continuing to watch cb-pool-3; kv keys trending down steadily. we should keep cb_disable_for_customer for acct-3745 until we root cause.

alice: agreed. next steps: 1) collect request traces for acct-3745 showing prefix entropy; 2) reproduce locally with synthetic payloads; 3) examine mutation in client 'session_per_prompt' code path.

fiona: I'll reach out to product/contact at acct-3745 to notify them of mitigation and ask for opt-in to debug sessions.

bob: post-mortem checklist: timeline, root cause (likely high-entropy prefixes from feature), why batch_window change amplified, mitigation steps (per-customer flag, kv ttl), follow-ups (client fix, safer server-side guardrails e.g. max unique prefixes per session).

alice: I'll create incident doc and link to this thread.

1789457320 alice: marking incident as mitigated. leaving thread open for follow-up. :white_check_mark:

emily: thanks team. support will close customer ticket after contacting the customer.

carlos: fyi, we will schedule canary test for batch_window change in staging with high-entropy clients.

bob: add action to add a server-side quota on new prefix creation rate to avoid future blowups.

incident-bot: Incident MITIGATED at 1789457320. Severity: Sev2.
